I took my dog ​​with chronic kidney failure (IRIS Stage 3, creatinine 296, urea 20.2) to VetDent for a dental treatment due to a pus infection around a molar and multiple dental problems. The treatment was a complete failure, and afterwards it turned out that the medical care was severely substandard and life-threatening for a kidney patient. My dog ​​received heavy injectable anesthesia using, among other things, Dexdormostart and Ketexx (Ketamine). According to the official medical package insert, ketamine is strictly contraindicated (forbidden) in animals with renal insufficiency because the kidneys cannot excrete it. Furthermore, this practice did not even have a ventilator! As a result, my dog ​​did not fall asleep, became stressed, and his vulnerable kidneys suffered a massive, toxic blow. It is fortunate that the treatment was stopped and that I immediately administered 500 ml of subcutaneous fluids at home myself to dilute the harmful medication; otherwise, my dog ​​might not have survived due to acute kidney failure. A clinic that presents itself as a dental specialist ought to know that you should never sedate an IRIS Stage 3 patient in this manner, and certainly not without a ventilator and IV. I strongly advise owners of dogs with a medical risk against going here. Very unprofessional and risky.

I deeply regret going here.
Because, once again, the official medical package insert for Ketamine states very clearly that the medication should not be used in animals with severe kidney disorders. The fact that they administered it anyway, regardless of the amount, remains a major medical error of judgment.
Top dental clinic. We came here with our Doberman, who is quite anxious about the vet, but he was looked after very well. Friendly, skilled, and thoughtful staff, and excellent (after)care!

Our dog Coco has a chipped molar and we were referred to the clinic by our vet since we really wanted to save the tooth. Dr. Magnus and the team did manage to save it and reconstruct part of the chipped tooth. He has been very friendly and patient with our questions and I feel he wants to do what's best for our dog. I highly recommend him!

Mr. Souverein helped our cat with dental problems very well. He gave good advice and neatly removed damaged teeth.

Linda spoke to me very kindly and took the time to think things through.

Thank you for taking such good care of our cat Evie! <3
We lost our dog because of this "VET" he only cares about money and has no other interest at all. Its basicly a scam

DO NOT GO HERE!! THEY MURDERED OUR DOG.

Last year, we took our dog to VetCare for a dental cleaning. What should have been a simple procedure ended in disaster – resulting in our dog's death.

We explicitly stated beforehand that our dog is allergic to cats. Yet, after the procedure, we found him in a cage, right next to a cat. This alone is a testament to complete negligence.

Furthermore, his throat was not properly sealed during the cleaning. As a result, fluids and bacteria entered his airways. He developed a severe infection and died a week later after much pain and suffering.

To make matters worse, we were also saddled with a bill of €1,500, without any form of responsibility or apology from their side. No aftercare, no sympathy, no explanation – just a dead dog and an empty wallet.

We want to warn other pet owners: think very carefully before having your animal treated here. What happened to us could have been prevented with a little professionalism and attention. Unfortunately, their negligence cost us our loyal friend.
I received excellent care today during the consultation for the cat with a loose canine tooth. The very professional Dr. Souverein provided a detailed explanation. I look forward to the treatment.

This clinic was recommended by our vet. And it was definitely the best decision we’ve made. It’s a cozy place - something you don’t see that often in vet clinics. There was no stress at all and the employees were incredibly sweet and communicated in a very pleasant way. We really appreciate your expertise, care and help. Laszlo will be her old self soon, thanks to you! ❤️
